quotations.old_english: HSt hie of ðam líge near ætgongan
quotations.english: he bade them from the flame to approach nearer

source_text: æt-gongan [æt at, gangan to go] To go to, approach; accedere :-- HSt hie of ðam líge near ætgongan he bade them from the flame to approach nearer, Exon. 55b; Th. 197, l; Az. 183.
